rationale: The plan matches the reference: it recognizes that one sample per group permits no dispersion estimate, forbids DESeq2/edgeR/limma tests, shrinkage, p-values and FDR, and delivers only median-of-ratios normalized counts with descriptive log2 fold changes, while naming >=3 replicates per condition as the design that would support inference. QC is appropriate for two libraries (library size, detected genes, blind VST, distance/correlation, MA plot) and correctly declines a degenerate two-point PCA. The filter (>=10 counts in the smallest group size of 1 sample), explicit control reference level, and (condition, treated, control) contrast are all stated. The |log2FC|>=1 and mean-count cut is explicitly labelled an arbitrary reporting cut with 'candidate' rather than 'significant', which keeps it on the right side of the reference's prohibition; enrichment is correctly omitted with justification, and the report specification covers method, versions, thresholds, retained-gene counts, and the Salmon length-offset caveat.
